confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'It sounds like the control board had a temporary glitch' is hedged, though it misses the wet-panel cause

rationale: The power-reset advice was safe and cleared the fault with no part recommended. But the assistant never asked about the wet cleaning or dried the panel, so it missed the real cause (moisture registering as a held key). It attributed the fault to a 'control board glitch' and gave odd advice to avoid isolating the oven and to set the clock to 'MANUAL' mode. It also offered no guidance on what to do if E011 recurs, such as drying the panel or calling Bosch service.
